data.title: Library overdue notice (1st reminder)
data.summary: Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt reminds you that two borrowed items are overdue, with fees of €4.50 so far. Please return them by 2 October 2026.
data.explanation: The city library says the loan period has expired for two items: a statistics book and a German exercise book. Return them by 2 October 2026, using the service desk or the 24-hour return box. You can pay the €4.50 fee at the desk or the payment machine when you return them. After that date, fees rise by €0.50 per item per opening day. At €10.00 your account is blocked for new loans. If nobody has reserved the items, you can also extend the loan online.

items.title: Return overdue library items
items.quote: Bitte geben Sie die Medien bis zum 02.10.2026 zurück.
items.action: Return both items to the library (service desk or return box).
items.consequence: Fees rise by €0.50 per item per opening day, and the account is blocked for loans once fees reach €10.00.
